projects.title: 1.Liver Tumor Detection
details: Developed a deep learning model using CNN to detect liver cancer from MRI scans by processing images with masks, grayscale conversion, and segmentation to isolate the liver.
It aims to assist radiologists by automatically highlighting and categorizing tumor regions in MRI images, improving early detection and diagnosis without the need for a medical practitioner.
Tech Stack: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV.

projects.title: 2. Intelligent Garbage Classification
details: Developed an intelligent garbage classification system using deep learning techniques to enhance waste management and recycling practices.
The system accurately classifies different types of waste, thereby improving efficiency in sorting and recycling processes.
Tech Stack: HTML,CSS, Java script, Flask, Python
